column1: # Source-owned DistSQL context chunk-RPC policy evidence.

column5: Rust now owns EnableChunkRPC in the canonical DistSqlContext request state, copies it on detach, and feeds it directly to the existing alignment-gated DAG encoding policy instead of accepting a duplicate caller boolean. The same context already preserves the dependency-closed warning, request, routing, paging, session identity, kill/cancel, CPU/KV, and fresh max-keys-counter subset. Go client identity, rate limiting, trackers/statistics, error/timezone authority, resource-group callbacks, TiFlash limits, closest-read adjustment, and cop-lite-worker transport remain unrepresented until real consumers exist.
